meta.parties: Subasinghe Et Al. v. Palaniappa Pillai

rules.statement: A person who during the pendency of a hypothecary action purchases the property under mortgage, in execution of a money decree, may intervene under the provisions of section 6, sub-section (3), of the Mortgage Ordinance, No. 21 of 1927, but such intervention may be permitted only before the distribution of proceeds of sale under the mortgage decree.
